meta.method: Extracted from production Webflow `:root` tokens (CSS) + GSAP ease analysis (offbrand.main.js) + Playwright reference screenshots. Quantitative values are authoritative from source, not visual estimates.
meta.platform: Webflow + custom three.js / Rive / GSAP bundle
meta.truthRule: For any module: colors, type scale, spacing, radius, easing, breakpoints MUST come from this file. Effects mechanics MUST come from docs/effects/*.md.

color.note: All hex values verbatim from `:root` in lando.shared.css. Roles inferred from usage + screenshots.

--color--dark-green.role: Primary dark surface (footer, dark sections, off-track)

--color--black.role: True black (text on light, deep backgrounds)

--color--white.role: Primary light surface (hero, light sections) — warm off-white

--color--dark-green-tint-1.role: Dark surface tint 1 (raised elements on dark)

--color--lime.role: PRIMARY ACCENT — McLaren-papaya-adjacent electric lime. CTAs, active states, highlights

pairings.rule: Hero & on-track default to LIGHT; footer & off-track default to DARK. Lime #d2ff00 is the single signature accent used sparingly.

body.name: Mona Sans Variable
body.role: All UI, body, nav, buttons (workhorse variable sans)

scale.note: rem values verbatim from `--text--*` tokens. Base context assumed 16px.

--text--impact.role: Marquee / oversized display (e.g. ON TRACK / OFF TRACK)

treatment.eyebrows: Uppercase, tight tracking, ~9–10px, often Brier or Mona Sans uppercase
treatment.displayWeight: Brier Bold, sometimes stretched via font-stretch (Mona Sans wdth axis)
treatment.letterforms: Editorial, slightly humanist; large negative space around display type

spacing.rhythm: Vertical sections separated by large ~31vh spacers; generous negative space is core to the brand.

elevation.philosophy: Mostly flat / editorial. Shadows used sparingly.

breakpoints.note: Webflow max-width cascade. Mobile-first base styles; overrides at each max-width.

gsapEases.dominant: expo.inOut / expo.in / expo.out  (matches CSS signature curve)
gsapEases.scrub: ease:'none' — scroll-bound timelines progress linearly with Lenis scroll
gsapEases.rule: Entrances/exits use expo; scroll-scrubbed sections use ease:none (progress = scroll position).

principles: Smooth-scroll (Lenis) is global; everything feels inertia-driven.
Reveals decelerate with expo — slow-out, never bouncy.
Scroll-scrubbed pin/horizontal sections map 1:1 to scroll progress (no easing on scrub).

visualLanguage.composition: Generous negative space; off-grid editorial layouts; large display type offset by tiny uppercase eyebrows; asymmetric balance.
visualLanguage.imagery: High-contrast photography (helmet, on-track) + abstract topographic/fluid line motifs + vector Rive line-art (circuits, signature).
visualLanguage.texture: Mostly flat with subtle organic line overlays; minimal shadow; material = matte paper (light) / carbon (dark).
visualLanguage.colorDiscipline: Strict — warm off-white vs. warm dark-green duotone, with ONE electric lime accent used as a magnet for attention (STORE, active, highlights).

interactionTemperament.pace: Slow, inertia-driven; never jumpy. Lenis smooth scroll sets the cadence.
interactionTemperament.feedback: Vector (Rive) micro-interactions on buttons/icons; scroll-scrubbed reveals; WebGL helmet reacts to scroll velocity.
interactionTemperament.personality: Engineering-precise but warm. Motion is patient and decelerating (expo).

brandVoice.tone: Understated, first-person, competitive-but-classy ('Always bringing the fight.')
brandVoice.signature: Tiny uppercase eyebrows + huge Brier display = the brand's typographic signature.

compositionRules: Hero = light surface, topographic motif, top-left wordmark, top-right lime STORE CTA + menu toggle, bottom-left 'NEXT RACE' card.
Marquee bands use impact/oversized Brier on dark or lime.
Sections alternate light/dark to create rhythm; lime is the only chromatic punctuation.

checklist.summary: Global Lenis smooth/inertia scroll; drives all scroll-bound motion.
Pinned + horizontal (`is-horizontal-track`) sections, reveal-on-scroll, marquee, SplitText heading reveals. Scrubbed with ease:none.
Interactive buttons via btn-ui.riv state machines (hover/press/invert). data-rive-* attributes wire inputs.
Hero/section decorative loops: signature.riv, circuits.riv, reef.riv, phrases.riv, ln4.riv, mob-landscape.riv.
three.js scene in window.landoGL: scroll-driven 3D helmet (helmet-21.glb), disco (disco-02.glb), tracks (tracks.glb); custom shaders; fed by Lenis velocity + reveal uniform.
Hero abstract flowing/topographic line motif (WebGL shader or Rive circuits) on light surface.
